win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 19. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
The global multiplier is displayed next to the reels and multiplies all wins. It starts at x1 and increases by x1 on every tumble win.

 In the base game it gets reset back to x1 at the start of every spin.

wilds.name: ZEUS WILD REEL
wilds.behavior:
When the Zeus symbol lands it triggers and spawns between 1 and 5 Wild reels on the grid.

 After it has been activated, the Zeus symbol acts as a regular Wild symbol, substituting for all other symbols in the paytable.

 The Zeus symbol can land in all game modes and maximum one unactivated Zeus symbol can be present on the grid at the same time.

wilds.name: BONUS SCATTER SYMBOL
wilds.behavior:
The Bonus scatter symbol can only land in base game. Only one Bonus scatter symbol can land per reel.

 The Bonus scatter symbol cannot be on the same reel at the same time as a Zeus Wild reel.

 The Bonus scatter acts like a FS symbol

multipliers.name: GLOBAL MULTIPLIER
multipliers.behavior:
The global multiplier is displayed next to the reels and multiplies all wins. It starts at x1 and increases by x1 on every tumble win.

 In the base game it gets reset back to x1 at the start of every spin.

multipliers.name: WHEEL OF FORTUNE
multipliers.behavior:
When Thunderstrike Bonus or Lord of Lightning Bonus are triggered, the player will have the chance to gamble for a chance to win additional free spins and a higher initial global multiplier.

 The player can gamble up to 3 times or collect the currently awarded free spins and global multiplier at any time before a gamble.

modes.name: BONUS GAME - THUNDERSTRIKE
modes.trigger: landing 3 Bonus scatter symbols at the same time in the base game.
modes.effects:
Trigger the Thunderstrike bonus with 10 starting free spins and a x1 initial global multiplier by landing 3 Bonus scatter symbols at the same time in the base game. 

 This bonus follows all base game mechanics. In addition the global multiplier starts at x1 and is persistent throughout the whole bonus, increasing by x1 on every tumble win.

 Each gambling round results in the following amount of free spins and initial global multiplier based on the outcome:

 First gamble:

 Collect: 10 free spins / x1 initial global multiplier

 Gamble Win: 15 free spins / x5 initial global multiplier

 Gamble Loss: 0 free spins

 Second gamble:

 Collect: 15 free spins / x5 initial global multiplier

 Gamble Win: 20 free spins / x10 initial global multiplier

 Gamble Loss: 0 free spins

 Third gamble:

 Collect: 20 free spins / x10 initial global multiplier

 Gamble Win: 25 free spins / x15 initial global multiplier

 Gamble Loss: 0 free spins

modes.name: BONUS GAME - LORD OF LIGHTNING
modes.trigger: landing 4 Bonus scatter symbols at the same time in the base game.
modes.effects:
Trigger the Lord of Lightning bonus with 15 starting free spins and a x5 initial global multiplier by landing 4 Bonus scatter symbols at the same time in the base game. 

 This bonus follows all base game mechanics. In addition the global multiplier starts at x5 and is persistent throughout the whole bonus, increasing by x1 on every tumble win.

 Each gambling round results in the following amount of free spins and initial global multiplier based on the outcome:

 First gamble:

 Collect: 15 free spins / x5 initial global multiplier

 Gamble Win: 20 free spins / x10 initial global multiplier

 Gamble Loss: 0 free spins

 Second gamble:

 Collect: 20 free spins / x10 initial global multiplier

 Gamble Win: 25 free spins / x15 initial global multiplier

 Gamble Loss: 0 free spins

 Third gamble:

 Collect: 25 free spins / x15 initial global multiplier

 Gamble Win: 30 free spins / x20 initial global multiplier

 Gamble Loss: 0 free spins

evidence.quote_or_excerpt:
ABOUT THE GAME

 Ascend to Olympus in Arc Lord! This 5-reel, 5-row game with payline wins crackles with divine energy as the mighty Zeus symbol summons 1 - 5 Wild Reels with every strike. Symbols that are part of a winning combination are removed from the grid and new symbols drop in their place. Each tumble fuels the storm, raising the global multiplier by x1 for thunderous wins worthy of the gods! Gamble on the Wheel of Fortune for extra spins and a higher global multiplier for bigger wins!

 The max win in this game is 25 000x your bet and can be achieved only in the bonus games.

 FEATURES
